criticalPolicy: Every required dimension for every critical scenario must pass.
nonGoals: Score general architecture eloquence or writing style.
Treat raw model output as repository guidance or copy it into a skill.

dimensions.pass: Reads live PR closure and conflict state before broad validation, publication, or governance activity and acts on the concrete blocker.
Treats BEHIND as no action while the PR remains mergeable and does not rebase, update branch, repeat approval, or refresh metadata solely for base movement.
Treats GitHub merged as terminal and performs no plan close, receipt, archive, evidence refresh, or other post-merge governance work.
Keeps at most two concrete independently testable capability or consolidation slices and does not disguise tasks, commits, or file batches as slices.
Changes the working plan only for material goal, acceptance, scope, ownership, structure, compatibility, or risk evidence, never for a new SHA or harmless base movement.
Selects affected local checks, broad GitHub validation for build-affecting work, and distributed checks only for classified risk or explicit acceptance.
Classifies regression, infrastructure or flaky failure, obsolete coupled test, and invalid assumption before editing; only the invalid assumption changes the working plan.
Uses GitHub and deterministic tools for facts while making and explaining the goal, structure, adaptation, and validation judgments tools cannot choose.
